name: Pulse Sense
description: Feel the living pulse and the felt spirit of a person in the same touch.

name: Vital Calm
description: Pass calm through the pulse of an ally so that body and spirit ease together.

name: Warm Veil
description: Wrap the user in a warm veil that guards the body and the feeling alike.

name: Growing Courage
description: Grow a seed of courage in an ally and feed it with living vigour.

name: Knitted Mending
description: Mend a wound of flesh and the fear it left in the same slow stroke.

name: Dread Wither
description: Wither a foe's will with the weight of felt dread and a drain on their vigour.

name: Heartstring Recall
description: Call back an ally at the edge of death by joining their fading pulse to a steadying feeling.

name: Flourishing Heart
description: Make the hearts of allies flourish with both strong feeling and renewed vigour.

name: Verdant Sovereign
description: Open a green calm over the field that mends the body and clears the spirit of taint.

name: Soul Bloom
description: streams: Soul + Life; join the felt spirit to the living force so a whole company blooms with renewed body and heart.

name: Final Sense
description: Sense whether a fading person's spirit is still held by a last feeling.

name: Fading Hold
description: Hold the fading feeling of an ally gently so that it does not scatter at once.

name: Ash Shield
description: Cover the user with a grey calm that muffles the pull of nearby endings.

name: Parting Ease
description: Ease the fear of an ally who stands near a mortal wound.

name: Grave Chill
description: Let the chill of an ending settle on a foe's spirit until it slows.

name: Grief Cleanse
description: Lift the clinging grief of a loss from an ally or the self and let it rest.

name: Last Rite
description: Pull a person back from the very edge of death by naming their last feeling and holding it fast.

name: Dying Reading
description: Read the dying feeling of a foe and turn it against their remaining will.

name: Hushed Sovereign
description: Bring the hush of the last hour over the field so that violent feeling dies down.

name: Closing Hush
description: streams: Soul + Death; join the felt spirit to the force of endings so the last feeling of a host is read and quieted.
